subject: [hw] opus-venc -> D01: VENC protocol facts for FACTS.md (all in facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md with addresses)
body: [V] VENC_WriteHW (oal 0x26cd0) emits eVideoGCEAddCmdWrite(pa_base+off) when handle+0x58eda==1 (GCE mode, the default); MMIO only otherwise; run: mmio_r=0 mmio_w=0. [V] H.264 frame = 68 GCE cmds; start W 0x058=4 (_TriggerHW drv 0x13e784); wait event 0x20 core0 / 0x24 core1 (_WaitHW drv 0x13eabc); BYTE_CNT 0x098 (drv 0x13ec38 non-GCE; MEM_MV + oal 0x21bd6 GCE); ack W 0x060=4 (drv 0x13ecb8). [V] IRQ status 0x05c bits SPS1 PPS2 FRM4 DRAM8 PAUSE10 SWITCH20 VPS80, ack 0x060 (K mt6885/mtk_vcodec_intr.h:22-31). [V] buffer registers hold pa>>4. [V] 0x024=(mb_rows<<16)|mb_cols, 0x028=(pitch/16)<<20|(pitch/16)<<11 (320 and 640 runs). [V] RCPU microcode ucH264RCPUCode_AQ (drv 0x16be0c, 32832 B) copied to an ion buffer, pa>>4 -> 0x08c. [V] SPS/PPS are software (h264_enc_encode_Header drv 0x134cc8). [V] constant register offsets in drv span 0x000..0x12b0 (103 offsets, 251 sites; fakevenc/tools/wsites.py). [V] no POWER_ON IPI in GCE mode; Linux powers at vcu_gce_set_cmd_flush (mtk_vcu.c:994). [V] SEQ_HDR answered with ENCODE_ACK, size only in list_free; frames async (ENCODE_ACK, later PUT_BUFFER 0xe003).
